messages:
priya: quick thread — need to lock scope for JSON mode / structured-output validation + retry semantics for the API surface. customer asks are getting specific (LegalTech, FinOps) for strict schema guarantees.

priya: core questions: validate-only vs server-side auto-repair+retry, streaming interaction, metrics & rollout requirements.

noah: short Q — do we make server-side validation fail-fast (400-with-schema-errors) or do an automatic second-pass retry with a 'fix prompt'?

maria: ML POV — auto-repair is high risk. models often 'fix' by inventing fields. prefer validate-only + strongly-typed error payloads so customers can choose programmatic retries.

tom: UX: dev ergonomics matter. SDK should show field-level pointers, example corrected JSON, and a documented error code list. maybe a `suggested_fix` field but opt-in.

kevin: ops concerns: we need metrics before GA — validation_fail_rate, retry_success_rate, p95 latency WITH validation enabled. watch tail-latency spike if we add retries.

priya: propose phased approach: Phase 1 = validate-only mode (server validates output against provided JSON Schema, returns structured error). no server-side fixes. Phase 2 = opt-in suggest-and-retry that returns candidate corrections and can replay a second request.

noah: rough eng estimate: validate-only + error contract + SDK surface = ~2 sprints frontend + 3 sprints backend + infra for schema registry/tracing. exact after SRE input.

maria: also need an eval harness and regression tests per model/version to detect when validation pass-rate drops (models change with quant/ops).

priya: launch criteria (draft): docs + SDK examples, schema registry, console tracing & per-route metrics, alerts on validation-rate regression, canary on Dedicated, and at least 2 pilot customers committed.

tom: design callout — how do tool/function-calling and JSON mode interact? If a model can call tools and also produce structured JSON, which takes precedence?

maria: agreed — tool outputs should be treated as first-class inputs into validation. if a tool returns structured data, validator should accept it as the canonical output. Validator runs after tool output resolution.

noah: implementation edge-case: streaming output + schema validation. partial JSON in stream is invalid until complete; proposal: buffer until final close then validate. that will add latency and blocks streaming UX.

priya: tradeoff: default to no streaming for strict JSON mode. provide a ‘streaming_heuristic’ flag for customers who want incremental partial validation (best-effort).

kevin: suggested rollout: opt-in per-route, 1% traffic canary 48h, then 10% 24h, then 50% 72h. add automatic fallback to freeform text if repeated validation failures (>3 consecutive requests) to avoid customer outages.

priya: PLG/marketing needs: quickstart templates and sample prompts for Legal, Finance, Customer Support. also clear docs on error handling and retry patterns.

tom: example SDK snippet (proto) for catching validation errors and doing client-driven retry:
```js
try {
  const res = await redwood.chat.create({
    model: 'rwd-foo',
    mode: 'json',
    schema: mySchema,
    messages: [...]
  })
} catch (e) {
  if (e.code === 'SCHEMA_VALIDATION') {
    console.log('invalid fields:', e.details.invalid_fields)
    // optionally call local fixer or prompt template then retry
  }
}
```

maria: evaluation targets: require >=95% schema-pass on representative prompt set for GA. Phase 2 auto-suggest success must be <5% of total requests (so we don't hide model drift).

noah: I'll draft an API spec + error contract + example SDK surfaces and open a PR by EOD tomorrow.

priya: thanks — can SRE/infra owners add their estimates for registry storage/retention and console tracing costs? kevin?

kevin: will add infra cost and retention impact. main costs: schema registry, storing sample failing payloads, increased traces retention for debugging.

ops-bot: deploy plan created: `/deploy canary-jsonmode v1` -> scheduled, notify #eng-oncall if regressions.

priya: closing notes — I'll turn this into a roadmap card with phased scope, launch criteria above, and ping sales for two pilot commitments. will follow up with PR link when noah posts the spec. Thanks everyone.
